response.justification: Bogdan Szabo is a technically excellent, versatile senior/staff-level engineer with strong open-source, Linux, and architecture experience (including founding and running his own platform), but the resume shows only 'Basic' German against a stated minimum C1 requirement for a client-facing consulting leadership role, and it lacks explicit evidence of formal team leadership, UML modeling, or IT security/compliance work, all of which are core to this Head of Development/Tech Lead position.
strengths: Extensive, diverse hands-on experience across web, mobile, embedded and backend systems with many languages (TypeScript, DLang, Node.js, Java, C#) showing strong technical adaptability.
Deep open-source and Linux affinity, including founding and maintaining an open-source Geo-Data platform (GISCollective) deployed on Kubernetes.
History of knowledge-sharing and mentoring via workshops, talks, and courses (FOSS4G, Selenium, Web Internals), indicating communication and teaching ability.
concerns: German proficiency listed as only 'Basic', far below the required minimum C1 for client advisory work.
No clear track record of formal team leadership, project management, or mentoring a multidisciplinary team in an employed capacity (mostly individual contributor roles).
No explicit mention of UML, requirements management, IT security/risk/compliance experience, which are called out as required skills.

key_factors.factor: German language proficiency below required C1
Lack of demonstrated formal team leadership/management experience
Strong open-source, Linux, and architecture background
